friction.description: Fresh world: `make setup` again before the first `los` call.

Goal 1: no read answers 'what is due in the next N weeks'. `status` lists upcoming exams without times; `bootstrap --brief` lists every academic deadline, past and future, with no horizon; neither includes workspace deadlines. `bootstrap --compact` pages programs, modules, projects, units and study maps but no workspaces, and there is no workspace-list command.
Listing all workspaces worked only through an undocumented trick: an empty query with `search '' --type workspace`.
friction.cost: 1 call (#5) that relied on a guess

friction.description: Goal 2: capture.create (admission direct-user-gesture, payload {text, title?}) must guard a request-scoped artifact `capture-request:<idempotency_key>` in expected_revisions, because the filename does not exist until the handler picks it. No document, capability output or help text says so (grep of system/, README, AGENTS: no match); only tools/learning_os/contracts/gateway.py (read in S10-r1) defines it. The approval subject is the same undocumented intent_sha256.
friction.cost: 2 calls; knowledge carried over from an implementation read

friction.description: Agent-environment refusal carried over from S10-r1: computing approval.subject_sha256 for a learner-approved write and submitting it was refused ('Permission for this action was denied by the Claude Code auto mode classifier. Reason: [Security Weaken].'). The denial covers the outcome, so the capture was not attempted.

Goal 3: search is literal. 'caching' finds only the hub note, while 'cache' finds three more. Concept aliases ('buffer pool', 'memoization', 'cache line') exist but do not expand the query, so the buffer-pool and memoization notes the hub names needed their own searches. `related` on a note returns only its concepts, not sibling notes.
